description: Google Business Profile administration. Actions: update_location(location, title?, phone?, website?, description?, regular_hours?) where regular_hours is [{"day":"MONDAY","open":"09:00","close":"17:00"}], create_post(location_name, summary, action_type?, action_url?), reply_to_review(review_name, comment). Destructive (confirm:true): delete_post(post_name), delete_review_reply(review_name). location is locations/<id>; location_name is accounts/<id>/locations/<id>; post_name and review_name come from gbp_list_posts and gbp_list_reviews.

params.description: Action parameters; destructive actions also need confirm: true

name: gbp_admin
